settings.question: What do you know about Diffusion Language Models?

interface_defaults.question: What do you know about Amsterdam?

answer: Diffusion language models are a type of generative language model that uses a diffusion process to generate text. This process involves gradually adding noise to the input sequence of the text, and then gradually removing the noise to generate the desired text. Diffusion language models have been shown to produce high-quality text, but they can also be more difficult to train than other types of models.
